metadata.description: mitate — deterministic animated scenes from any input.

plugins.name: mitate
plugins.description: Turn any input — a document, a codebase, a mechanism, a joke — into a deterministic animated scene. Films of any register (explainer, game cutscene, meme, character short) on the three.js node stack (WebGPURenderer with WebGL2 fallback, TSL node materials, MaterialX procedural noise) plus a Canvas2D backend, delivered as self-contained HTML, frame-exact MP4, or animated WebP/AVIF. 見立て: to see one thing as another.
